item.title: quahkm: Someone asked me at Fanexpo Dallas what will be my next subject matter if I were
item.author: Alan Quah
item.description:
Someone asked me at Fanexpo Dallas what will be my next subject matter if I were to draw a comic cover in an everyday scene. I have done a diner, a comic shop, a few street scenes, a ramen shop, offices, subway and many others. I told him a train.
Here is Erica doing what she does best inside a train, an Alan Quah Exclusive wraparound cover for my dear friend from @frostymugcomicsandmore . If you see yourself in the background, you probably did.
Something is Killing the Children #50 is now available at their Instagram page. Go check it out.
Art and colors by Alan Quah Studio and Colorism Studio.

item.title:
transformersbattersea: His first official figure is here. 🔥
The @yolopark.official AMK Pro Model Kit
item.author: Transformers Battersea
item.description:
His first official figure is here. 🔥
The @yolopark.official AMK Pro Model Kit brings Powerplex to life with a die-cast skeleton, premium paint, and light-up LED eyes, along with exclusive collector bonuses.
Only 5,000 up for grabs at £120. Pre-orders are open now. ⚡
From spark to titan.
Powerplex's story started as a concept by @frederic_pham_chuong in February 2025 and has grown into a full origin story, a community-voted name, and now his first-ever figure and comic book. Here's how it all came together.
#Powerplex #transformers
Before he ever touched Earth, Powerplex tore across the galaxy in his Spaceship Mode 🚀
Now he's a true triple changer cycling between robot, power station, and siege mode. Which mode is your favourite? 👀
Got your hands on the Powerplex comic book yet? 📖
Here are the creatives who brought the story of the Battersea titan written by Simon Furman to life with beautiful artwork which changes as you read through the story.

item.title: talkingjoecomics: Mark and Tim talked with writer Dan Watters danpgwatters and artist Pye Parr @py
item.author: Talking Joe
item.description:
Mark and Tim talked with writer Dan Watters danpgwatters and artist Pye Parr @pyeparr about the new M.A.S.K comic from Skybound ahead of the release of issue 1 on 10th June.
This interview references the MASK story from Energon Universe Special 2026 but is spoiler free for MASK # 1
Youtube link https://youtu.be/-v6zW8NFsI8 Audio only podcasts in normal places, links at https://talkingjoe.co.uk/#Podcasts
M.A.S.K. #1 arrives in comic book shops on Wednesday, June 10, 2026 from the powerhouse team of writer Dan Watters (Batman: Dark Patterns, DESTRO), artist Pye Parr (Petrol Head, New Gods), colorist Pierluigi Casolino (DC vs Vampires), and letterer Rus Wooton (TRANSFORMERS).

item.title: pyeparr: Had a couple of comments recently that my transformers art looks like AI, which
item.author: Pye Parr
item.description: Had a couple of comments recently that my transformers art looks like AI, which I find depressing beyond belief. Both that some people can’t tell the difference, and the implied insult that they don’t believe I’m good enough to create work without using the plagiarism machine to churn out regurgitated drek. Anyway, as an opportunity to post some process stuff and as an answer to these fuckwitted twats here’s a rough layer/progress breakdown of my recent transformers poster. #transformers #fuckai #transformersbattersea #optimusprime #powerplex
